Basis: Balanced funded-order fixture proves constant-inventory price skew is repeatedly reapplied to endogenous last price (40–160 ticks/40 balanced cycles). No-skew four completed development charts have much smaller waves but weaker movement. Reserve delay alone preserves/increases movement but fails shape gates across all six cases.

Variants.inventory-delta: Apply changes in rounded own inventory reservation discount, rather than repeatedly applying its full level to last. Persist last discount without additional RNG. All other baseline mechanisms remain.
Variants.no-skew-reserve-delay: Factorial interaction: combine independently tested no-skew and existing Reserve refill-delay semantics. Tests whether changed depth availability restores useful movement after removing recurrence.

Gates: All original and added gates unchanged; independent holdouts still untouched.
